Headhunter.summary: Almost never a raw drop you plan around. Farm The Doctor (8) in Burial Chambers / Spider Forest / Overgrown Shrine style maps, or The Hunt where it still drops.

cards.name: The Doctor
cards.where: Burial Chambers, Spider Forest, Overgrown Ruin

notes: World drop exists but is not a realistic SSF plan.

Mageblood.summary: Chase unique. Farm The Price of Devotion / relevant cards if enabled this league; otherwise treat as a lucky world/boss drop.
notes: Do not plan a league around this dropping.

Watcher's Eye.summary: Drops from Elder, Uber Elder, and related Maven/Uber content. The roll is the item — farm many copies.
notes: Shaper/Elder map bosses and Uber Elder are the classic sources.
Matching the name is not enough; you need the right aura mods.

Bottled Faith.summary: Drops from Venarius in Cortex (the Synthesis unique map). Wait for his post-fight monologue before leaving.

cards.name: Succor of the Sinless
cards.where: Sanctuary and related Synthesis map content

notes: Not a Sirus drop. Farm Cortex (or The Feared). Uber Venarius is a different unique pool.
Shaper map fragments → Shaper fight. Uber Shaper also drops it.

Progenesis.summary: Uber Maven drop (The Maven's Cry / Uber Maven).
notes: Invitation + Uber Maven. Not the normal Maven fight.
Need the Uber Eater fight, not the atlas Eater.
Uber Exarch, not the atlas Exarch.

Ralakesh's Impatience.summary: World drop unique. Run maps at or above its drop level; it is relatively common compared to chase uniques.

The Ivory Tower.summary: World drop. Farm high-level maps; not boss-gated.

Windripper.summary: World drop unique bow. Maps at a high drop level; no specific boss.

Asenath's Gentle Touch.summary: World drop gloves. Common enough to farm passively while mapping.

Goldwyrm.summary: World drop boots. Often shows up while mapping; not boss-specific.

Inspired Learning.summary: World drop jewel. Farm maps; multiple copies are normal in SSF.

cards.name: The Jeweller's Boon
cards.where: check wiki for current drop areas

Lioneye's Fall.summary: World drop jewel. Roll-dependent if a build needs a specific allocation.

The Surrender.summary: Can world-drop; The Innocent (10) is the targeted farm for the shield.

Kaom's Heart.summary: World drop and The King's Heart (8). Kaom's Stronghold / volcanic maps are traditional flavour, not a guarantee.

cards.name: The King's Heart
cards.where: Kaom-themed maps and high fire maps

Xoph's Blood.summary: Breach unique from Xoph. Open Xoph breaches / Xoph's Domain (Chayula/Breachstones as applicable this league).

Rise of the Phoenix.summary: World drop armour. Farm high-level maps.

Rumi's Concoction.summary: World drop flask. Mapping is the farm.

Kaom's Roots.summary: World drop boots. Fairly common while mapping.

The Bringer of Rain.summary: World drop helmet. Classic mapping unique; 6-link is a separate project (or Tabula / vendor 6L).

Shavronne's Wrappings.summary: World drop ES armour. High drop level maps.

Presence of Chayula.summary: Chayula Breach unique. Run Chayula breaches / Chayula's Domain.
notes: Pure Chayula Breachstone is the targeted farm.

Capricious.summary: World drop sceptre. Confirm the exact unique name on wiki if it was renamed this league.

Heartbound Loop.summary: World drop ring. Common mapping unique.

Skin of the Lords.summary: Uber Atziri / Apex of Sacrifice / The Alluring Abyss. The implicit is the item.
notes: Farm Vaal fragments, then Atziri, then Uber Atziri.
Roll-dependent: you need the right keystone implicit.

Skin of the Loyal.summary: Atziri in The Apex of Sacrifice (normal Atziri).

Forbidden Flesh.summary: Searing Exarch drop (atlas boss). The allocated notable is everything.
notes: Farm Exarch invitations. Matching the name is not enough.

Forbidden Flame.summary: Eater of Worlds drop (atlas boss). Notable must match the build.
notes: Farm Eater invitations.

Goldrim.summary: Very common world drop. Campaign and maps both drop it constantly.

Tabula Rasa.summary: Common world drop, or The Celestial Justicar / Humility cards. Vendor 6-socket whites if you only need the 6-link.

Wanderlust.summary: Levelling unique. Drops throughout the campaign.

The Baron.summary: World drop helmet. Used for spectres / minion block setups.

Quill Rain.summary: World drop bow. Common; campaign and maps.

Voltaxic Rift.summary: World drop bow. Higher drop level.

notes: Same fight as Dying Sun / Shaper's Touch line.

Aegis Aurora.summary: World drop shield. High drop level maps.

Svalinn.summary: World drop shield. Often found while mapping.

notes: Run Ultimatum encounters through to The Trialmaster.

The Saviour.summary: Sirus drop. Weapon has variable implicits.
notes: Roll-dependent.

Thread of Hope.summary: Searing Exarch drop. Radius/keystone layout is the roll.

Impossible Escape.summary: Eater of Worlds drop. Keystone allocation is the roll.

Elegant Hubris.summary: Timeless Jewel from Eternal / Legion (Cadiro). Farm Legion encounters / timeless splints.

Voices.summary: Delve unique jewel. Deep Delve cities / Kurgal / Ahuatotli / Niko content.
notes: 1-passive Voices is the chase roll.

Megalomaniac.summary: Delve unique jewel. Cluster notables are random.

Large Cluster Jewel.summary: Not a unique in the usual sense — cluster jewels drop from Delirium. Farm mirrors / Delirium maps.
notes: Treat as a crafting project, not a unique name match.

Split Personality.summary: Delve unique jewel. Attributes/life rolls vary.

The Green Nightmare.summary: Upgrade path from The Green Dream (Chayula / Breach related). Check wiki for the exact vendor/blessing recipe this league.

The Red Nightmare.summary: Upgrade from The Red Dream via Breach blessing recipe.

The Blue Nightmare.summary: Upgrade from The Blue Dream via Breach blessing recipe.

The Green Dream.summary: Chayula / Esh-adjacent Breach unique. Farm the matching Breach.

The Light of Meaning.summary: Unique jewel with variable mods. World drop; rolls matter.

Inpulsa's Broken Heart.summary: World drop body armour. Popular mapping unique.

Belly of the Beast.summary: World drop life armour. Very common.
